items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: And Bird Guard Adams as well.

ctx.x: Was there much, of course, I know you didn't get around to all the bar rooms, but I mean, do you think there were many bands working there, like on Saturday nights every week in some of the small places, maybe two or three musicians? Did Bunk ever work any little jobs like that, Justin?

Well, that's what, yeah, that's what I told him and his Uncle Henry used to work little jobs like that. And Bird Guard Adams as well. And this was, I think it was just four of them. I can't remember, the other one's name was Minor. I don't know, I forgot his name. But he died. But he was playing banjo. And they used to work little jobs like that on Saturday night at a, let me see what this was, a place of man was. They used to work there every Saturday night, this man named, I forgot his name. He had a place of…
